name: table-3
title: Invoice Line Items Summary
description: Invoice line items table with quantity, unit, and unit price columns plus a footer summing subtotal, tax, and total due.

standards.purpose: Compare structured records row by row with columns that stay readable.
useWhen: Records share the same fields and are compared across rows.
doNotUseWhen: Records are heterogeneous or mainly discovered by scanning cards.

rules.check: Cells are associated with header cells via th/scope or an equivalent accessible table.
Numeric columns are right-aligned with consistent precision.
Per-row actions are keyboard reachable and labelled with the row's identity.
An empty table states that there are no records and offers a next step.
